examined_formations.title: SMALL_FARM_AGRICULTURAL_SERVICE_ORCHESTRATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 小农户农业托管服务编排层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current 2026 programs already select qualified service entities, aggregate smallholder demand through collectives/托管员, use formal service contracts and increasingly require information-platform/telemetry oversight. The delivered value remains plowing, sowing, crop protection and harvesting in the field.

examined_formations.title: ASSISTIVE_DEVICE_RENTAL_AVAILABILITY_AND_FIT_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 康复辅具租赁可用性与适配路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Real users report difficulty knowing what can actually be rented, cross-district constraints and providers unwilling to rent some high-end devices. But current policy is explicitly building platform+center+station networks, and the residual value requires fitting, home trial, delivery, instruction, maintenance, disinfection and recovery.

examined_formations.title: SHARED_HIGH_END_LAB_CAPACITY_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 高端实验仪器共享容量路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Suzhou and Hefei are opening high-end analysis/testing platforms to enterprises, proving real resource sharing. But sample preparation, method selection, instrument configuration and result interpretation remain expert services, while the host lab/platform owns equipment scheduling and acceptance.

examined_formations.title: PET_INSURANCE_LIFECYCLE_HEALTH_COORDINATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 宠物险全生命周期健康协同层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Pet insurance adoption is rising rapidly and insurers are expanding from reimbursement toward lifecycle health management. The strongest data asset is insurer-owned claims/provider history while diagnosis/treatment remains professional veterinary delivery.

examined_formations.title: AUTOMOTIVE_AFTERMARKET_CROSS_SERVICE_ORCHESTRATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 汽车后市场跨服务编排层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Repair, insurance, rental, RV/camping, motorsport and classic-car services are being encouraged as growth areas, but the broad bundle does not identify a narrow unowned action loop; physical service networks, insurers, rental companies and specialized operators retain execution.

examined_formations.title: INDUSTRIAL_REMANUFACTURING_RESOURCE_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 工业再制造资源路由层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Industrial remanufacturing and circular-economy activity is expanding, including newer equipment categories, but collection, inspection, repair, certification, inventory and resale are physical/capital-intensive industrial operations rather than a thin founder-independent control edge.
